description: Na₆Se₂O₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with three SeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one SeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.82 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with three SeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one SeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.51 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.59 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.67 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with three SeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a faceface with one SeO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-49°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.55 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.91 Å. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-64°. There are three shorter (1.68 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) Se-O bond length. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-68°. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.68 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-64°. There is one shorter (1.67 Å) and three longer (1.68 Å) Se-O bond lengths. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to six O atoms to form SeO₆ octahedra that share faces with four NaO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.88 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form ONa₅Se octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids, and faces with four ONa₅Se octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form ONa₅Se octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, and faces with four ONa₅Se octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form ONa₅Se octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Se octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Se trigonal pyramid, and faces with four ONa₅Se octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-83°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-71°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Se atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form ONa₅Se octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids, and faces with four ONa₅Se octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form ONa₅Se octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Se trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramid, and faces with four ONa₅Se octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom.
